title: A twelve-case firewall validation plan
method: Synthetic test matrix: four web-allow cases, three management-allow cases, three inbound-deny cases, and two IPv6 control cases total twelve. Counts describe planned coverage, not security effectiveness or observed customer outcomes. Each required case must be evaluated by meaning, not an average pass percentage.
alt: A twelve-case firewall validation plan. Illustrative values: Web allow cases 4 test cases, Management allow cases 3 test cases, Inbound deny cases 3 test cases, IPv6 control cases 2 test cases.
